text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of Mayano Top Gun's final showdown with Narita Brian has arrived—the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although she has grown into an even better racer, her dream of "twinkling" has not changed…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clutching that dream, she heads off to race Narita Brian.
